issue: screencapture silent failure — no output, no error
cause: macOS screen recording TCC permission revoked mid-session. screencapture exits silently with code 0.
fix: Switch to screenshot-based recording via Chrome DevTools MCP take_screenshot. No TCC permission needed.

issue: stale screencapture segments — 29min and 13min files from short scenes
cause: screencapture process not killed between persona switches. Orphaned processes recorded indefinitely.
fix: Screenshot-based recording is stateless — no long-running processes to orphan.

issue: missing video segments discovered only after full flow completed
cause: No per-segment verification. Only discovered missing segments during assembly.
fix: Recorder.logScreenshot() verifies each file exists and is >1KB immediately after capture. Failures logged as errors.

cause: Permission can be revoked by macOS at any time (Privacy settings, OS update, Terminal app update) with no runtime notification.
fix: Screenshot-based recording uses Chrome DevTools Protocol, which requires no OS-level permissions.

issue: agent thinking pauses captured as dead time in video
cause: Real-time screencapture records everything, including 5-30 second pauses while the agent plans next action.
fix: Screenshot-based recording captures discrete states. No dead time by design — each frame is an intentional capture.

issue: narration disconnected from screenshots in action log
cause: session-narrate generated audio but didn't log to action-log.jsonl. Narration timing was lost.
fix: session-narrate now logs narration entries (action: narration) with text, audioFile, durationMs. Also writes .pending-narration-duration consumed by next session-capture.

issue: frame numbering off-by-one (0000.png logged as frame 1)
cause: session-capture counted files on disk via find, but current file already existed. session-scene hardcoded frame: 0.
fix: Both commands now count from action-log.jsonl entries (previously logged screenshots). Frame numbers match filenames.

cause: grep -c with 0 matches prints '0' and exits 1. '|| echo 0' prints another '0'. Variable captures first, second leaks.
